attempts.head: 50fd8a9c37336999ee89b31d55ac837c1b8388eb
attempts.observation: Acquisition refused the checkout manifest because its bytes did not match the frozen SHA-256.
attempts.cause: Windows Git checkout line-ending conversion; the committed LF blob still matches the original frozen hash.
attempts.correction: Set core.autocrlf=false on the ephemeral hosted runner before checkout; retain all hash assertions.
